e0-context.title: Load baseline context
e0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, docs/architecture/packets/latent_power.md, ADR 0001 and ADR 0008. Confirm the resolved understanding (interrogation.json consolidation) and protected intent: preserve Student-t heavy-tail robustness, leave the mean (mu) objective unchanged, latent_power must not import evo. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: orchestrator context + glossary + latent_power packet + ADR 0001/0008 loaded; resolved understanding and protected intent confirmed

g1.title: Cleanup: retire triangle_loss + dead bce path (retro_delta becomes the sole canonical path)
g1.imperative: Remove triangle_loss and the bce training path so retro_delta is unconditional. Concretely: (a) delete triangle_loss from losses.py and its call + lambda_tri usage in modules.loss_from_pairwise and any n_triangles/lambda_tri config plumbing that is now dead; KEEP symmetry_loss and regularization_loss. (b) Remove the bce branch in modules.loss_from_pairwise; make supervised = student_t_nll unconditionally. (c) Remove bce from config.ALLOWED_TARGET_MODES, models.LossBundle.ALLOWED_TARGET_MODES, the bce validation branches in training.py, and the run.py --target-mode bce choice; retro_root becomes mandatory (not conditional). (d) Remove bce from gold_cycle VALID_TARGET_MODES. Pin target_mode to 'retro_delta' as the only valid value (do NOT remove the target_mode field/plumbing or touch the committed report schema in this gate — full target_mode-concept removal is a triage candidate). (e) Update/remove all affected unit tests (bce-mode tests in test_modules.py, target_mode tests in test_config.py and test_gold_cycle_config.py, triangle tests). batch.outcome stays (eval metrics use it). No new behavior is introduced in this gate.

postconditions.statement: triangle_loss + dead bce path removed; symmetry kept; retro_delta unconditional; full latent_power + gold-config suites green
no residual bce/triangle references remain in src (grep clean except batch.outcome eval usage)

constraints: test-led; run focused region tests before and after
use py for python
latent_power must not import evo (ADR 0001)
prefer one canonical execution path; no vestigial dual-mode branches
do not change the committed gold report schema in this gate

g2.title: Sigma-calibration core: detached Student-t NLL term + lambda knob + solve-side W-cap
g2.imperative: In latent_power only. (a) Add a detach_mu variant of student_t_nll (or a thin wrapper) that computes the residual with pairwise.mu.detach() while leaving pairwise.sigma attached; reuse config.student_t_nu (shared nu). (b) Add lambda_sigma_nll: float = 1.0 to LatentPowerConfig with validation (>= 0). (c) In modules.loss_from_pairwise add term B = lambda_sigma_nll * detached_student_t_nll(...); add sigma_nll to LossBundle and include it in total. (d) Add a solve-side W-cap to field_solve: new LatentPowerConfig knob (e.g. solve_sigma_floor, default ~0.05, validated > 0 and >= sigma_floor) applied as sigma_for_solve = clamp(sigma, min=solve_sigma_floor) before W = 1/sigma**2; training sigma_floor (1e-3) untouched. (e) Unit tests: B reduces to 0 at lambda=0; B detaches mu (mu.grad unaffected by B); sigma gradient increases with lambda; LossBundle.sigma_nll present and finite; config validation for both new knobs; field_solve W-cap bounds W and preserves the solve at large 1/sigma**2.

preconditions.statement: g1 complete: retro_delta is the sole path, triangle gone

postconditions.statement: term B + lambda_sigma_nll + solve W-cap implemented; latent_power loss/config/field_solve suites green
reviewer approves (detach correctness, shared nu, robustness preserved, W-cap numerics)

constraints: test-led
use py for python
latent_power must not import evo (ADR 0001)
preserve Student-t heavy-tail robustness; mean (mu) objective unchanged (B must detach mu)
tunable weights live in config, not inline

g3.title: Evo wiring + gold-cycle passthrough
g3.imperative: Wire lambda_sigma_nll end-to-end on the evo side. (a) run.py cmd_train_latent_power_module: set lambda_sigma_nll on the constructed LatentPowerConfig and add a --lambda-sigma-nll CLI arg (default 1.0); add solve_sigma_floor passthrough if exposed at CLI. (b) gold_cycle/config.py: remove the lambda_sigma_nll != 0.0 rejection; keep it a validated float (>= 0). (c) gold_cycle/runner.py _module_train_args: pass lambda_sigma_nll (and solve_sigma_floor if applicable) into the train args. (d) Confirm build_run_config already records lambda_sigma_nll / pairwise_sigma_nll_enabled (it does) - no report schema change. (e) Update gold config tests: replace test_nonzero_lambda_sigma_nll_raises with a test asserting nonzero is accepted and plumbed; ensure run_config round-trips the value.

preconditions.statement: g2 complete: config knob + term B exist in latent_power

postconditions.statement: lambda_sigma_nll plumbed run.py->training and gold-cycle->training; gold rejection removed; gold-cycle suites green
reviewer approves (end-to-end wiring, no dead rejection, defaults correct)

constraints: test-led
use py for python
evo owns F1-specific wiring; do not leak F1 specifics into latent_power
no committed report schema change (fields already exist)

g4.title: Smoke validation: sigma develops dynamic range; field_solve conditioning holds
g4.imperative: Run a research/smoke-mode training (not full gold) on a small slice to validate the path end-to-end with lambda_sigma_nll=1.0. Capture: (1) trained sigma distribution per module (min/median/max, fraction pinned at solve_sigma_floor), especially race-start; (2) field_solve conditioning proxy (max W, condition number or sigma_pi_trace finiteness); (3) no NaNs/training divergence; (4) a quick backtest sanity (no catastrophic Brier blowup vs the pre-change smoke). Confirm sigma now varies meaningfully (the status-quo failure was ~10-17 near-constant). Decide final solve_sigma_floor from the observed distribution. Save evidence under .agent-work/issue-142-sigma-calibration/evidence/g4-smoke.md.

postconditions.statement: smoke evidence captured: sigma dynamic range materializes + conditioning holds + no divergence; solve_sigma_floor finalized
reviewer approves smoke evidence and the finalized W-cap value

constraints: use py for python
no F1 live data; DB is canonical source
evidence is machine-checkable (captured numbers), not impressions
if sigma pins at the floor or conditioning degrades, adjust solve_sigma_floor and re-run before closing

g5.title: Full gold retrain + Brier-primary comparison + promotion + docs
g5.imperative: Run the full gold cycle with the new canonical path (lambda_sigma_nll=1.0). Produce: (1) Brier-primary comparison vs the current promoted gold baseline (log-loss + reliability supplemental) - require no regression, report any improvement; (2) sigma_pi_trace dynamic range and corr(sigma_pi, accuracy) vs the prior baseline (issue target: beyond 4-40x range and -0.77 corr); (3) promote params/gold bundles + sampled_runtime_manifest.json. Then update docs: docs/architecture/packets/latent_power.md (losses.py no longer bce/triangle; Student-t canonical; sigma trained) and ADR 0008 (target_mode now single-valued; sigma NLL calibration term). Save comparison + promotion evidence under evidence/g5-gold.md. Surface Brier result to the human (run.accept happens at the spine review gate).

preconditions.statement: g4 complete: smoke validated, W-cap finalized

postconditions.statement: full gold retrain completed; Brier-primary comparison vs baseline captured (no regression); sigma_pi range/corr captured
params/gold bundles + sampled_runtime_manifest promoted; promotion evidence recorded
latent_power packet + ADR 0008 updated to reflect retro-only canonical path + sigma calibration
reviewer approves gold comparison, promotion, and docs

triage_candidates.statement: Full removal of the target_mode concept (field + gold config + committed report schema field + reports) with a schema version bump and consumer updates - deferred from G1 to keep the cleanup gate bounded and avoid a schema cascade.
Per-(phase, scope) student_t_nu tuning (ADR 0008 deferred); add |r/sigma| percentile instrumentation to decide if nu=4 is wrong now that sigma is actively trained.
Optionally allow a separate nu for the sigma-calibration term B (currently shares config.student_t_nu); revisit only if smoke/sweep shows the shared nu is limiting.
